description: Alpine lake (Hallstatt-like) with a mountain/cliff backdrop. A long traditional wooden boat (orange-brown varnish, high upturned bow on the right) with one standing boatman at the stern (left) moves left-to-right, side-on to the camera, across the whole clip. Camera slowly pans right and rolls ~1 deg.

camera.motion: slow pan right + slight tilt + roll; no zoom
camera.method: LK-tracked background features (y<555) vs frame 0, RANSAC similarity; residual ~0.2 px; cross-checked by template matching of 4 background patches (agree within ~2 px)
camera.stabilised_frame: x_stab / y_stab columns = positions mapped into frame-0 pixel coordinates (background-fixed)

objects.name: boat
objects.distinguish: only boat in the video; orange-brown wood, long and low, upturned pointed bow at right, square dark stern post at left, small wooden seat/box structures mid-deck, blue fender/rope at about 1/3 from the stern
objects.reference_point: x_img/y_img = centre of the above-water bounding box (stern..bow tip, bow-tip top..waterline); x_stab/y_stab = same point in frame-0 background coords
objects.direction: left to right (+x), roughly constant pace with poling-stroke surges

objects.name: boatman
objects.distinguish: only person; stands near the stern (left end) of the boat, black shirt and shorts, face pixelated, works a long oar/pole on the starboard (near) side
objects.occluded: legs/feet hidden behind the gunwale; visible height = head top to the deck/gunwale

objects.name: oar_pole
objects.distinguish: thin dark shaft held by the boatman, slanting down to the water near the stern; blue fender/rope piece on hull at ~x stern+100

objects.name: wake
objects.distinguish: white line on the water behind (left of) the stern at the waterline (y~672 at frame 0), plus a fainter older wake line at y~632

left_wooded_headland.note: dark tree-covered point at far left edge

radio_mast.note: small lattice tower above the treeline

static_objects_frame0_px.mountain_cliffs: grey limestone cliffs, top of frame; forested slopes; right slope dark green
static_objects_frame0_px.note: these are kilometres away; their pixel sizes are NOT on the boat's scale

events.event: boat still moving at end, no stop

perspective: boat seen side-on at nearly constant distance (stabilised waterline y 672-676 throughout); apparent length shrinks ~3 % (352 -> 341 px) over the clip, probably slight yaw/receding; single planar scale is appropriate
